message.content: Hey, I need to prep for the week. Can you draft a shopping list for dinner? I’m thinking of making that mushroom risotto again.

content.text: Sure. Based on your usual pantry stock, you’ll need Arborio rice, white wine, parmesan, butter, and fresh thyme. Do you need me to add the mushrooms and shallots to the list?

message.content: Yes, please. Also, check if I have any chicken stock left. I think I might be out.

content.text: You bought a carton last Tuesday. It should still be good for a few more days, but I’ll add it to the list just in case you want to top it up.

message.content: Good call. Add it. And maybe some garlic bread mix since I don’t want to bake from scratch tonight.

content.text: Added. I’ve sent the list to your phone. Anything else for the week?
